name: Priya Iyer
bio:
Priya's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination with engineering, sparked by watching Formula 1 races with her father. After graduating with a degree in aerospace engineering from IIT Madras, she pursued internships at various automotive companies before landing a coveted position at Ipiranga Racing. Over the past five years, she's honed her skills as a wind tunnel operator, meticulously analyzing aerodynamic data and contributing to the team's car development program.

Priya's pragmatic approach to problem-solving, combined with her deep understanding of fluid dynamics, makes her a valuable asset to the team. She's known for her ability to quickly identify and address potential issues, ensuring that the team's wind tunnel testing is always efficient and accurate. Her colleagues often praise her collaborative spirit and her willingness to share her knowledge with others.

What sets Priya apart is her dedication to continuous improvement. She is constantly researching new technologies and methodologies in aerodynamics, seeking ways to enhance the team's performance. Her analytical capabilities and calm demeanor under pressure make her an invaluable member of the Ipiranga Racing team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, braided hair often tied in a neat bun.
physical.description: Priya is of average height with a slender build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic calculations.
Insists on precisely calibrating all wind tunnel instruments before each test run.
Has a habit of humming softly while analyzing data, a habit she's unaware of.
